author.name: The Future of Korea Desk
author.bio: Future of Korea's editorial desk covers the Korean economy, technology industry, capital markets, demographics, and life on the peninsula for an English-speaking audience. Every article is researched against primary sources — Bank of Korea, Statistics Korea, KRX, FSS, ministry releases, and company filings — and reviewed by a human editor before publication.
